research_question: Do sleep spindle densities differ between two fixture sleep stages across a cohort of twenty-four participants?
falsifiability_criteria: If spindle density does not differ between the stages at the preregistered threshold, the hypothesis is falsified.
primary_endpoint: Mean spindle density difference between stage two and stage three

null_model.description: stage labels permuted within subject, 1000 permutations

known_leakage_risks: the same night contributes epochs to both stages and could leak subject identity across folds
preprocessing_steps: spindle detection with fixed amplitude and duration thresholds
measurement_limitations: scalp recordings limit spindle source localisation
claim_language: We hypothesize that spindle density differs between stages; this is a correlational analysis.
replication_plan: Replicate on an independent sleep cohort.

privacy_measures: access restricted to the study team
